method: One fixed reference/source foreground encoded-RGB-luma gain;5x5 sigma1 feather inside the original edit mask. Source geometry and relative shading retained. No generated pixels consulted.
limits: Encoded RGB is not linear-light luminance or calibrated reflectance. Foreground annotations are required; their automatic estimation is not validated.
foreground_method: Known fixture oracle: largest high-saturation yellow source component within unchanged edit mask, external contour fill; largest green reference component. HSV10..35 or35..85,s>=160,v>=60. Source/ref only, no generated pixels.
intervention: Foreground-only fixed brightness gain; original source/reference/edit masks/positive prompt/sampling fixed versus luma+description.
product_limit: This annotation oracle is not generic segmentation and cannot be silently promoted to the app.
